we introduce two prompting methods as follows: (i) Discrete scoring prompts the LLM to assign discrete scores from the set 0, 1, 2 for a given statement and its citation, where 1 indicates full support, 0 indicates no support, and values between 0 and 1 indicate partial support. guideline: Categorize citations into one of three categories of support levels: full, partial, or no support.
Annotators label each statement‑citation pair as full support, partial support, or no support.

We adopt the definition of these support levels from Liu et al. ( ): • Full Support (FS): the citation fully supports every detail in the statement. • Partial Support (PS): the citation supports certain aspects of the statement, while other details remain unsupported or are contradicted. • No Support (NS): none of the content in the statement is supported by the citation.
